classes_note: Keyed on tropo-validate section headings, truncated at the first parenthesis so a version tag in the heading cannot silently unmatch the entry.
counter_gap_note: The validator's `failed` counter (166) exceeds the itemized finding lines (157) by 9. Those 9 increment the counter without emitting a classifiable [FAIL]/[ERROR] line under a section heading, so no class can account for them. This gap is REAL and is why the previous record could not be reconciled: its `classes` summed to 172 against a `failed` of 163 — classes EXCEEDING the total, which is impossible if classes partition it, so that pair was never from one run. Both numbers here are from ONE run (see recorded_at_sha). Filed for v1.91: a gate that cannot show its work for 9 of its own findings is the misaimed-instrument class.
how_to_update: Pay debt down, re-run tropo-validate, lower this number, and say why in `reason`. Raising it requires a deliberate decision recorded here — a ceiling that rises quietly is the failure this file replaces.

gating_classes.UID Consistency: a governed file whose declared uid contradicts its filename is unreachable by every index and every reference built over it; if that shape ships it is baked into every installed studio — the unreconstructable-identity category of deb77758

gating_classes_note: OPT-IN. A class stops a build ONLY if it is named here with the irreversible harm it prevents, per Mike's standing ruling deb77758 (2026-08-09). Every other class reports; growth in an untriaged class is printed under 'reporting-only' on every run, so nothing hides. Curated 2026-08-25 by argus-a158 on Mike's explicit authorization, restoring what the approved v1.86 retrospective plan specified ('ratchet gates on a curated class list'); the inversion to an exemptions allow-list happened during implementation with no decision record. MEASURED BASIS: of 148 findings live at curation time, 1 sat in a class warranting a stop; ZERO of the 18 classes examine a byte that reaches a customer (the shipped box carries no vault/files, no index, no events, no agent memory); and 9 of the 18 are pinned at a print cap and cannot register growth at all.
gating_splits_owed: TWO genuine block-grade invariants are currently unreachable because they are buried inside hygiene-majority classes and cannot be gated without also gating the hygiene. 'Agent Identity Unified' also enforces one type:agent entry per slug (two identities answering to one name is identity corruption). 'Event Log Integrity Checks 1-10' also enforces duplicate-immutable-event-identity and per-writer local_seq monotonicity (ledger corruption). Both sub-checks fire ZERO today. They must be split into their own classes and added above — until then this list is knowingly incomplete, and that is recorded here rather than left to be rediscovered.
